name: Arjun Verma
bio:
Arjun's journey into motorsport started unconventionally, fueled by a childhood fascination with Formula 1 broadcasts in his small village. He pursued a business degree with a focus on organizational psychology, always aiming to bridge the gap between human potential and high-performance environments. After graduating, he interned at a local automotive company, quickly realizing his passion lay in nurturing talent, not just managing processes.

He believes a strong HR department is the backbone of any successful motorsport team. Arjun is driven by a desire to create a supportive and innovative workplace where every team member can thrive. He focuses on identifying and developing talent, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, and ensuring fair and equitable practices. He's eager to bring a fresh perspective to driver management, focusing on their mental wellbeing and long-term career development, not just immediate race results.
